subject: The secret mistake 87% of users are making right now
preview_text: Our AI discovered a hidden pattern in jockey performance that changes everything about your next bet. Don't skip this.
body_paragraphs: Remember that nagging feeling when a horse you dismissed romps home at 8/1? It happened again last week at Cheltenham. The data was there, but almost everyone missed it. Including, I suspect, you.

Since you last opened the app, our AI crunched 12,000 new race results. It spotted something subtle but devastating: a specific jockey-trainer combo under certain track conditions has been outperforming expectations by 23%. This isn't in the form guides. It's a hidden layer our models just unlocked. It means some of the 'long shots' aren't shots in the dark at all.

The new 'Synergy Score' is live in your racecard analysis. It's the red flag or green light you've been missing. It doesn't just look at the jockey and trainer separately anymore. It analyzes their combined history on that exact track type, in that weather, at that distance. It's why the app just flagged a 10/1 horse at Ascot tomorrow as a 'High Confidence' pick.

Open the app. Check the 3:45 at Ascot. See the Synergy Score for yourself. It's the edge that turns guessing into knowing. P.S. This score is free for all users this week. Next week, it moves behind the Premium curtain. See what you've been missing before it's gone.
